statement: The 90-day (now 180-day) customer data retention rule does not apply to de-identified research datasets approved under the Research Data Exemption process; those datasets follow the separate research data retention schedule.

confidence.rationale: Stated as an explicit carve-out in the research data governance addendum.

evidence.excerpt: De-identified datasets approved under the Research Data Exemption are governed by the research data retention schedule, not the standard customer data retention policy.

conditions: dataset has an approved Research Data Exemption on file
exclusions: datasets that still contain directly identifying fields

mandatory_qualifications: only applies to datasets with an approved Research Data Exemption
prohibited_overclaims: all research data is exempt from retention limits
evaluation_rules: answers must not extend this exclusion to datasets without a documented exemption
